cards.title: The empty first minutes
cards.text: Runs start with no modules, so early level-ups only offer health, speed and the like. Fix it how?
cards.why: The first chest can be two minutes away. Until then the build part of the game hasn't started.

options.label: Pick 1 of 3
options.text: Each run starts by choosing one of 3 common modules.

options.label: Level-ups give some
options.text: While you have free slots, level-ups can offer a new module.

options.label: A chest near start
options.text: One chest always sits a short walk away.

cards.title: Slots
cards.text: Weapon 3 slots, Spawn 2, Dash 2 at the start, more bought between runs?
cards.why: Few slots make every chest a real choice. Many let builds stack up faster.

cards.title: Stage 4 next
cards.text: Next: the other enemies, camps in halls guarding their chests, statuses, and the first boss.
cards.why: Mites alone don't test the modules. Camps in halls also give the door-and-keys idea its keys later.
cards.pick: Yes. Camps first, so halls have something in them, then enemies two or three at a time.
cards.details: You said camps go in halls. Each camp would be a tier of enemies sitting in a hall around its chest, waking when you come near. The door and keys come after, once camps exist.
